form.label: IP Timeline Lookup
form.description: Allows for an analyst to query the GreyNoise IP Timeline functionality to retrieve a summary of scanning activity for the submitted IP. Requires an IP Timeline license to function.

search.query: $token_search_trigger$ | gniptimeline [| makeresults | eval ip_address = if(isnull("$tkn_ip_address_escaped$") OR "$tkn_ip_address_escaped$"=="", "", "$tkn_ip_address_escaped$") | eval days = if(isnull("$tkn_days_escaped$") OR "$tkn_days_escaped$"=="", "30", "$tkn_days_escaped$") | eval granularity = if(isnull("$tkn_granularity$") OR "$tkn_granularity$"=="", "1h", "$tkn_granularity$") | eval field = if(isnull("$tkn_field$") OR "$tkn_field$"=="", "classification", "$tkn_field$") | eval ip_address = ip_address | eval days = days | return ip_address days field granularity ] | eval time=strptime(timestamp,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") | eval date = strftime(time,"%Y-%m-%d") | table ip field date label timestamp | rename ip AS IP, field AS Filed, date AS "Event Date", label AS Label, timestamp AS Timestamp

condition.set: GreyNoise has not observed any recent activity with the provided parameters
No results were returned due to improper values in the parameters
No results were returned due to an unexpected reason: $result.message$
